g.text: Multi-Dimensional Governance Decision Tree: Scope Sensitivity • Administrative Exposure • Workspace Baseline Policy • Recency
Trigger: Policy set to 'Specific Google Data', 'Blocked', or 'Limited'
Action: Protected. Application adheres to least-privilege target posture.
"The Holy Grail": Locks down tokens to only approved scopes without future escalation.
Migrate tool to dedicated Service Account.
Threat: Blanket bypass for future scopes
Restrict or block until vendor verification complete.
Trigger: Marked 'Trusted' with ≤ 1 user & inactive > 30d. Action: Downgrade to 'Specific Google Data' to shrink attack surface.
App unconfigured and inactive > 30 days. Periodic hygiene review to revoke stale authorized grants.
